title: Shot picks
description: D103 (documentary plan, slice 3) — what a vision judge saw. Written by the `pick_shots` stage: for each visual item, the candidates a search returned, each rated 1-5 against its shot and the video's main idea, best first, with any corner logo it reported. Read by resolve_assets, which fetches the best-rated candidate at or above min_rating that is not already on screen, and falls back to the plain search for an item that has none.

enabled.description: false = the channel has pick off; the stage wrote this so a resumed video does not ask again

sheets.description: contact sheets judged (= vision calls that answered)

unjudged.description: items whose sheet the judge could not rate; resolve_assets asks the plain search for them

page_size.description: the search page this candidate came from, so fetching it hits the same cache entry

desc.description: what the judge says the thumbnail shows
